description: Fake Bank SMS with Shortened Link
input_text: Dear SBI customer, your account 5821 is suspended due to pending KYC update. Click immediately within 24 hours to verify: https://bit.ly/sbi-kyc-update

signals.signal: Suspicious URL shortener detected (bit.ly) hiding actual destination
Urgent account suspension warning paired with link

result.explanation: High risk phishing: Deceptive urgency or fake verification detected trying to steal credentials or financial data. • Suspicious URL shortener detected (bit.ly) hiding actual destination • Urgent account suspension warning paired with link
advice: DO NOT click any link, scan QR codes, or open attachments received in this message.
NEVER share OTPs, PINs, passwords, Aadhaar, PAN, or bank credentials over message or phone.
Report financial fraud attempts immediately to National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930.
Verify directly by visiting the official banking website or calling the toll-free number printed on the back of your card.

input_text: CONGRATULATIONS! You have won $1,000,000 in the International Mobile Lucky Draw. To claim your cash prize, pay a $150 processing fee via Steam Gift Card or Bitcoin to prize@lottery-winner.xyz

signals.signal: High-risk domain ending (.xyz) frequently used in fraudulent campaigns
Lottery/prize award requiring upfront fee via gift card or cryptocurrency

result.explanation: Fraudulent scam: Fraudulent prize, lottery, courier, or cryptocurrency/gift-card payment pattern detected. • High-risk domain ending (.xyz) frequently used in fraudulent campaigns • Lottery/prize award requiring upfront fee via gift card or cryptocurrency
advice: Legitimate lotteries or official agencies never ask for payment via gift cards or crypto.
If contacted by callers claiming to be police or customs ('digital arrest'), hang up immediately. Law enforcement does not conduct arrests over video calls.
Report financial and cyber frauds at https://cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

Immediately block the sender on all communication channels and restrict your social media privacy settings.
